title.name: Business model and pricing for science companies

overview.description: Platform, tool, service, therapeutic and product companies have irreconcilable economics. Choosing late is expensive.
objectives: Choose between platform, product and service deliberately
Price against value delivered rather than cost incurred
Recognise when a services business is funding a product business, and when it has replaced it
prerequisites: Technoeconomics, cost curves and willingness to pay

steps.intro: Platform, tool, service, therapeutic and product companies have irreconcilable economics. Choosing late is expensive.
instructions: Write your Lean Canvas in one sitting. Do not polish it.
State your pricing and the value it captures as a percentage.
Name the point at which services revenue would be a trap.

submission.description: No named deliverable. Work the steps and keep the notes with the module in Homeroom.
